statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-127040 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-11-18-2): in libgnutls, the server-side handling of the RSA-PSK client key exchange (_gnutls_proc_rsa_psk_client_kx in lib/auth/rsa_psk.c) did not return when copying the PSK username failed, which happens only when memory allocation fails, so the handshake carried on and could crash. The fix returns the error and aborts the handshake. Upstream says it was introduced in GnuTLS 3.7.7 and fixed it in GnuTLS 3.8.14, released 2026-11-18, with commit 8767518753a633e5ef59f112310db8dc9ff6771a: https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/8767518753a633e5ef59f112310db8dc9ff6771a, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/blob/3.8.14/NEWS . Alpine's 3.23-stable gnutls APKBUILD builds 3.8.14-r0 from the 3.8.14 release and lists CVE-2026-127040 under its 3.8.14-r0 security fixes: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/gnutls/APKBUILD . We downloaded every package built from the gnutls source in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository: gnutls, gnutls-c++, gnutls-dbg, gnutls-dev, gnutls-doc and gnutls-utils, each at 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0, 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 for x86_64 and aarch64, 48 apks, and checked each download against its index checksum; no gnutls package is published in the DHI Alpine security repository. The library code is in libgnutls.so.30 in the gnutls package; gnutls-c++ ships the C++ wrapper libgnutlsxx.so.30, the seven gnutls-utils programs list libgnutls.so.30 as a needed library, gnutls-dev ships headers, pkg-config data and the libgnutls.so and libgnutlsxx.so symbolic links and no static library, and gnutls-dbg ships debug symbols. The GnuTLS version string in libgnutls.so.30 reads 3.8.11, 3.8.12, 3.8.13 and 3.8.14 in the matching builds on both architectures. So 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0 and 3.8.13-r0 are affected and 3.8.14-r0 is the first fixed build.
